actions.description: Grants permission to initiate a bulk publish of all existing datasets for an Identity Pool to the configured stream
actions.name: BulkPublish

actions.description: Grants permission to delete a specific dataset
actions.name: DeleteDataset

actions.description: Grants permission to get metadata about a dataset by identity and dataset name
actions.name: DescribeDataset

actions.description: Grants permission to get usage details (for example, data storage) about a particular identity pool
actions.name: DescribeIdentityPoolUsage

actions.description: Grants permission to get usage information for an identity, including number of datasets and data usage
actions.name: DescribeIdentityUsage

actions.description: Grants permission to get the status of the last BulkPublish operation for an identity pool
actions.name: GetBulkPublishDetails

actions.description: Grants permission to get the events and the corresponding Lambda functions associated with an identity pool
actions.name: GetCognitoEvents

actions.description: Grants permission to get the configuration settings of an identity pool
actions.name: GetIdentityPoolConfiguration

actions.description: Grants permission to list datasets for an identity
actions.name: ListDatasets

actions.description: Grants permission to get a list of identity pools registered with Cognito
actions.name: ListIdentityPoolUsage

actions.description: Grants permission to get paginated records, optionally changed after a particular sync count for a dataset and identity
actions.name: ListRecords

actions.description: Grants permission to register a device to receive push sync notifications
actions.name: RegisterDevice

actions.description: Grants permission to set the AWS Lambda function for a given event type for an identity pool
actions.name: SetCognitoEvents

actions.description: Grants permission to set the necessary configuration for push sync
actions.name: SetIdentityPoolConfiguration

actions.description: Grants permission to subscribe to receive notifications when a dataset is modified by another device
actions.name: SubscribeToDataset

actions.description: Grants permission to unsubscribe from receiving notifications when a dataset is modified by another device
actions.name: UnsubscribeFromDataset

actions.description: Grants permission to post updates to records and add and delete records for a dataset and user
actions.name: UpdateRecords
